newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 5,932 to dollar for Jan 31-Feb 2 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 5,932 to dollar for Jan 31-Feb 2 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 5,932 to the dollar for January 31 to February 2.
The reference rate set on Wednesday is a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Tuesday for January 30 is 5,778 to the dollar. It was 5,738 on Wednesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
